```
def priority(f):
    p = f['progress']
    cd = f['cluster_density']
    sp = f['spread']
    nr = f['nearest_remaining']
    
    # Base weights with progress blending
    dw = 1.0 - 0.5*p  # Distance weight decreases more aggressively
    rw = 0.05 + 0.5*p*p  # Return weight grows
    rgw = (0.1 + 0.4*p*p)  # Regret base
    
    # Cluster-density-driven nearest_remaining weight
    nrw = 0.3 * cd * (1.0 - p)  # Boost nearest_remaining in dense areas early
    
    # Spread-based cluster tightness bonus - when spread is low (tight cluster),
    # amplify nearest_remaining to prioritize completing cluster
    tightness = max(0, 0.3 - sp)  # Higher when spread is low
    nrw += tightness * 0.5
    
    return -dw*f['distance'] + rw*f['return_distance'] + rgw*f['regret'] + nrw*f['nearest_remaining']
```
